title: Amazonian ayahuasca as a technology for building relationships with beings

tellings.quote: the Amazonians who developed Iawaska for example, you know, this is a true pharmacological technology.

plain: Ayahuasca, a psychedelic brew made in the Amazon, is in this view a tool the Amazonian peoples built for forming relationships with beings met in the altered state. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore says this to Michels without naming a source, calling it "a true pharmacological technology". If he is right, these peoples were working out a deliberate method of contact long before modern science studied DMT, the powerful psychedelic compound in the brew.
